name: botscript-monorepo
description: A small TypeScript-superset language designed for code that is mostly written by machines.

scripts.publish:all: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' publish --no-git-checks --access public
scripts.publish:check: for p in runtime compiler cli vite-plugin babel-plugin; do printf '%-32s ' "@mbfarias/botscript-$p"; npm view "@mbfarias/botscript-$p" version 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING; done
